notes.title: Version 1.2.0 Update!
notes.content:
In conjunction with our participation in the Steam Shmups Fest, we have made the following updates.

[b]- Some effects and SEs have been changed to enhance the feel of the game.[/b]

As a result, some effects will now conform to VRITRA HEXA, which is currently available in arcades.
Although the game has been on the market for more than 5 years, we hope you will continue to enjoy it!

notes.title: Update 1.1.0
notes.content:
- Caravan mode "SETSUNA VRITRA" added
- Some effects have been adjusted

notes.title: Update 1.0.3
notes.content:
- Supported Japanese. Menu UI / Story / Ending etc. is in Japanese.
- Restoration in case of saved data is invalid

notes.title: Update 1.0.2
notes.content:
- Fixed a case that an error might appear in the high score ranking
- Improved operability

notes.title: Update 1.0.1
notes.content:
- Fixed a case where "Embark" achievement could not be unlocked
- Adjust highscore screen
